description:
MONITORING: Quick status check for Terraform deployments
Check the current status of a Terraform deployment job.
Use this tool to quickly check if a deployment is running, completed, or failed.
Returns job status, job_id, and other metadata without streaming logs.
Use tflogs to stream the actual deployment logs.
REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...).
OPTIONAL: job_id to target a specific deployment (use tfruns to discover IDs).

**LIVENESS**: The response carries two distinct timestamps:
- `updated_at` — last semantic change (only bumped when status / drift / version actually differ).
  Useful for sorting deployments; NOT a per-poll heartbeat.
- `last_refresh_at` — last successful Oracle decode (stamped on every poll where reliable
  reached Oracle, even if nothing in the row changed). Use this to confirm reliable is
  still actively talking to Oracle for a long-running RUNNING job. Absent on rows that
  haven't been refreshed since the column was added.
💡 TIP: Examine workflow.usage prompt for more context on how to properly use these tools.

job_id.description: Optional. Specific job ID to inspect. When omitted, returns the status of the latest job for the session.

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing.

name: tfstatus

custom_presets_version.description: Terraform presets version InsideOut composed the stack with.

custom_template_version.description: Infrastructure template version InsideOut composed the stack with.

draft_version.description: Draft stack version number, when a draft exists.

drift_actionable.description: True when the drift would make Terraform apply changes; false when it is refresh-only noise.

drift_classification.description: Per-resource drift verdicts, when the drift check could classify them.

action.description: Terraform actions the drift would cause.

class.description: Drift class assigned to the resource.

reason.description: Why the resource got that class.

drift_detected.description: True when a drift check found differences from the deployed state.

found.description: False when the session has no job yet.

has_pending_changes.description: True when the draft stack differs from the deployed version.

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

job_id.description: ID of the job reported on.

last_event_id.description: Log cursor. Pass it to tflogs to fetch only newer entries.

last_refresh_at.description: Time the backend last polled the deploy runner for this job (RFC 3339).

plan_summary.description: Summary of the Terraform plan, for plan and drift jobs.

expected_tag_changes_only.description: True when every change is an import or an InsideOut tag update.

has_changes.description: True when the plan changes anything.

validation_issues.description: First-import plan gate violations, each with code, field, reason and value.

presets_version.description: Terraform presets version the runner used.

session_id.description: Session ID this status belongs to.

template_version.description: Infrastructure template version the runner used.

updated_at.description: Time of the job's last status change (RFC 3339).

version_id.description: ID of the stack version the job ran.

version_number.description: Number of the stack version the job ran.

title: Check Deploy Status
